subject: Ciências
description_pt: Selecionar argumentos e evidências que demonstrem a esfericidade da Terra.

components.description_pt: Identificar evidências observacionais e científicas que sustentam a forma esférica da Terra
components.description_en: Identify observational and scientific evidence that supports Earth's spherical shape
components.cc_component_description: Identify patterns in observational or experimental data as evidence for a scientific explanation

components.description_pt: Avaliar argumentos usados historicamente e atualmente para demonstrar a esfericidade da Terra
components.description_en: Evaluate arguments used historically and currently to demonstrate Earth's spherical shape
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the quality of evidence used to support a currently accepted scientific explanation

components.description_pt: Selecionar a evidência mais convincente para refutar concepções errôneas de Terra plana
components.description_en: Select the most compelling evidence to counter flat-Earth misconceptions
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the strength of a counter-argument based on the quality of its supporting evidence

cc_matches.description: Patterns can be used as evidence to support an explanation.
Evaluate the claims, evidence, and/or reasoning behind currently accepted explanations or solutions to determine the merits of arguments.
Construct, use, and/or present an oral and written argument or counter-arguments based on data and evidence.
